column1: # Model manifest for the adate inference stack.
# Format: <target path under /models>
# Lines beginning with # are ignored. Tab-separated.
# HuggingFace-first by policy: every entry below resolves without an account or a
# token. CivitAI-hosted models can be added here too and will use CIVITAI_TOKEN
# from the environment if one is set, but nothing required by the game needs it.
# Sizes are listed so a first boot's download is predictable: ~5.5 GB total.
# Counterfeit V2.5, fp16. SD1.5-family anime checkpoint, booru-tag dialect.
# Chosen for the 12GB co-resident target: at ~2.1 GB of weights and roughly 4 GB
# peak with IP-Adapter at 768px, it leaves room for an 8B Q4 LLM on the same card.
# The SDXL-family alternatives are better looking and do not fit that budget.
checkpoints/Counterfeit-V2.5_fp16.safetensors
# IP-Adapter Plus (full-image reference). NOT FaceID or InstantID: those depend on
# InsightFace embeddings trained on real faces and perform poorly on anime.
ipadapter/ip-adapter-plus_sd15.safetensors
# CLIP vision encoder the IP-Adapter reads its reference image through.
# Upstream calls this models/image_encoder/model.safetensors; ComfyUI wants it in
# clip_vision/ under a name that says what it actually is.
clip_vision/CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors
# BiRefNet is native in ComfyUI as of PR #12747, so this needs a model file but no
# custom node. Matting happens inside the graph and the client only ever receives
# PNGs with alpha (HANDOFF 6).
background_removal/birefnet.safetensors
# IP-Adapter Plus FACE. Trained on face crops, so it carries identity without
# dragging the reference's clothing and composition along with it -- which full-image
# Plus does hard enough to make outfit, pose and expression uncontrollable at any
# weight that preserves identity.
# Still CLIP-vision based, so it is safe on anime. NOT FaceID or InstantID: those use
# InsightFace embeddings trained on real faces and perform poorly here.
ipadapter/ip-adapter-plus-face_sd15.safetensors
